# My Signet Lite

> A web-based Nostr remote signer (NIP-46), built as a static React PWA. It holds your key on the
> device and signs for other Nostr apps over a relay, so your `nsec` never leaves it. Identities are
> derived from one BIP-39 mnemonic with `nsec-tree`. It is an application to clone and run, not a
> library to install from npm.

Supports connect, get_public_key, sign_event, ping, switch_relays, nip44_encrypt, nip44_decrypt and
nip04_decrypt (decrypt only). `nip04_encrypt` and `logout` are deliberately unsupported. Apps connect
through a `bunker://` link made in Lite or a `nostrconnect://` link pasted into it.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/README.md): features, quick start, supported NIP-46 methods, connecting a client with nostr-tools, layout
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layer rules, invariants and the verify sequence for coding agents
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability privately

## Source

- [src/engine/nip46.ts](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/src/engine/nip46.ts): NIP-46 parsing, NIP-44 and NIP-04 helpers, `SUPPORTED_METHODS`
- [src/engine/signer.ts](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/src/engine/signer.ts): the `Signer` class, authorisation, approval gating, bunker secrets
- [src/engine/relay.ts](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/src/engine/relay.ts): relay transport
- [src/ui/bunker-uri.ts](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/src/ui/bunker-uri.ts): the `bunker://` URI format

## Examples

- [e2e/bunker-full.spec.ts](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/e2e/bunker-full.spec.ts): a real `BunkerSigner` connecting through a `bunker://` link and getting a verified signature
- [e2e/nostrconnect-full.spec.ts](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-lite/blob/main/e2e/nostrconnect-full.spec.ts): the client-initiated `nostrconnect://` flow
